title: Ensuring Public Access to Golfing Facilities Given Closure of All Public Golf Courses by 2024
what_it_is: Ensuring Public Access to Golfing Facilities Given Closure of All Public Golf Courses by 2024

sections.label: Public golf course access
sections.summary: Mandai Executive Golf Course tenancy extended to December 2026, and Keppel Sime Course slots are set aside for public use.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: First, the operator of the Mandai Executive Golf Course has been granted a two-year tenancy extension until December 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Second, taking into consideration the impending closure of the 18-hole public course at Marina Bay Golf Course, the Government had earlier worked with Keppel Club to set aside slots at the Sime Golf Course for public use at an affordable price range, comparable to other public courses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Currently, the majority of slots at the Keppel Sime Course – on both weekdays as well as weekends – are set aside for members of the public.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The Government will also look into the feasibility of public golfing facilities for the longer term, bearing in mind other needs of Singaporeans, at the same time.

sections.label: More public golf slots
sections.summary: Government is working with Keppel Club to explore more slots, including possible night golfing at Keppel Sime Course.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: In the near term, we are working with Keppel Club to see if more slots could be made available.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: So, for instance, we are exploring the possibility of introducing night golfing at the Keppel Sime Course, for instance, and in the longer term, we will explore all other various options and make sure that public accessibility is one of our key considerations in doing this.
